title: Player profiles on comclient.xyz
body: Every public Com Client player now has a page at comclient.xyz/u/name with their 3D skin and cosmetics, level, play time, badges and PvP tiers. Leaderboards are there too.

title: Badges for developers, testers and early supporters
body: New icons next to the Com Client C on name tags and in the tab list. Everyone who joins before 2027 gets the Early Supporter star.

title: Faster start and mod updates
body: The launcher checks the game files in the background, so Play starts right away, and tells you when your mods, packs or shaders have updates.

title: Welcome to the Com Client launcher
body: Press Play: Minecraft, Fabric and Com Client are installed and kept up to date for you. Add mods, resource packs and shaders under Mods.

title: Feed, chats and message requests
body: The Social tab in the game now has a 24-hour feed, chats with friends and message requests.
